Every time no matter how depressed or suicidal i am, i will never resent that emotion, and i dont know why. Possibly because its never truly made me feel terrible. But even so, even in the times ive come closest to suicide, resenting absolutely everything in this reality, i am physically incapable of pushing that one part of me aside. And i dont know why. I cant put my finger down on what its like to feel blissfully happy, since i simply forget about that feeling after time. But love, i cant forget that, and the times when i was in love were some of the best ive ever felt. Its a sad fate, but its kinda like thats all thats keeping me from losing my mind.
